title: Ops Templates: Create listing drafts the release top-level pages, Road to live Listing asks a listing to cover them without system pages, and the Design Inspiration tab draws on first open
steps: Run the tracy-web listing-pages and road-to-live tests on the real tracy_site_pages.json and tracy_design_inspiration.json files of tracy-base emdash, tracy-business j6, ja-social-ii j6, ja-impact wp7 and ja-phio j6.
Run the harness ops-templates-feedback test that holds the first sheet read and bumps readKey.
expect: Create listing on Tracy Base EmDash drafts Home, Product, Service /services, Pricing, Resources /blog and Company /about though the demo menu read Home alone.
The draft never carries a system page, a not found page, a language root or a legal page, and breaks no rule of its own.

tracy-business j6 is flagged for Terms · Privacy, Русский and Not found; ja-social-ii j6 misses News and Contact Us; ja-impact wp7 misses Events and Blog and carries Authors and Login; ja-phio j6 is clean.
A hidden listing that breaks the rule is to do and Publish refuses LISTING_INCOMPLETE naming the pages; a published one only warns, stays published and nothing is refused.
Opening a template whose page re-read lands first draws the Listing form, not Reading….
fence: listingPagesOf + listingProblems in apps/tracy-web/src/lib/listing-pages.js are the one rule the drafter and the road read; the road warns, never holds, a published listing.

tests: EmDash: every page of the primary menu, its record slug mapped to the path it answers at
WordPress and Joomla: a page id is its path, so nested pages stay off the listing
at most six pages, in file order, with the home page first wherever the file lists it
no pages file: no page list to cover
Create listing on Tracy Base EmDash drafts its six pages, though the demo menu read Home alone
the demo menu fills the slots the pages leave, and its address and count are kept
a Joomla page the demo menu did not read takes the demo’s /index.php prefix
no pages file: the draft is the demo menu, as before
the demo menu never fills a slot with a system page or a language switch
Tracy Business Joomla: every page there, but Not found, Русский and Terms · Privacy may not be
JA Social II Joomla: a Home-only listing misses News and Contact Us
JA Impact WordPress: misses Events and Blog, and carries Authors and Login
JA Phio Joomla: its six top-level pages, nothing else, is clean
Tracy Base EmDash on dev (Home, Product, Service, Pricing) misses Resources and Company
no pages file: nothing is required, and system pages are still not allowed
the drafter’s own draft breaks no rule
polish without a listing still names the pages file, and never waits
a hidden listing that misses a page of the release is to do, names it, and holds Publish
a page without a desktop picture keeps the listing to do
a published listing that misses a page only warns: it stays published and nothing is held
a hidden listing carrying a system page is to do, and the refusal names it
7: a page re-read that answers before the first sheet read still draws the sheet, not "Reading…"
